notes.title: Massive update incoming
notes.notes:
My games receive love, tender and care even after a long time. That is why I am putting time and effort in updating this game, instead of releasing a new one.

Find the Gnome is getting a massive overhaul that will address all the issues with the 'old' version, and will massively improve the game-play.
[list]
[*][b]Keep the good[/b]. Click, interact, look carefully, spot the gnomes you need to catch.
[*]However, now with [b]more diverse gameplay[/b]. Some gnomes walk around, other gnomes hide in objects that you can interact with. You have to interact with the environment to 'open up' the level. Complete objectives and find hidden secrets.
[*]And [b]visual consistency[/b]. Fully hand modeled by me in the low poly artistic style.
[*]And [b]Improved sounds and music[/b]. With ambient music to accompany you during your play-through.
[*]And [b]a free moving camera[/b], as requested.
[*]And [b]more diverse content[/b]. The first version will ship with 3 unique levels with already more content then the 'old' version had. More levels will be added in the coming months with each update also adding more to find in the earlier released levels.
[/list]

The game currently is in beta testing. This is beta for the version that will release in approximately 8 weeks.

That's it for now folks!
